In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Sharad Hett]] led a group of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] in an '''attack''' on the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]]. One Tusken war clan rode into the town on [[Bantha/Legends|Banthas]] shooting and trampling things. While the citizens fought them off, another Tusken group composed of around a dozen clans rode in from the north. They killed six militiamen, set fire to the armory, smashed the central [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporator]], and stole some [[Water/Legends|water]] before fleeing.
